en_title: OpenAI Boss Sam Altman Addresses Backlash After Saying It Was 'Terrible' for People to Have RAM in Their PCs
cn_title: OpenAI老板Sam Altman称人们的个人电脑里有内存「很糟糕」后回应强烈反弹
opus_summary: OpenAI负责人Sam Altman此前称，从全球资源分配角度看，人们在个人电脑中配备大量内存很糟糕，引发广泛批评。他回应称自己的言论被断章取义，并表示希望世界拥有大量内存，让人们按需为电脑配置内存。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI boss Sam Altman has addressed the backlash over comments he made in a recent interview, where he said he thought it was “terrible” for people to have RAM in their PCs rather than a data center .
paragraphs.cn: OpenAI老板Sam Altman回应了他最近在一次采访中发表的言论所引发的强烈反弹。他当时表示，他认为人们把内存放在个人电脑里，而不是放在数据中心里，「很糟糕」。

paragraphs.en: Speaking to YouTuber Cheeky Pint , Altman said: "From a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world's limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer, and being used 5% of the time. Like, you want maximum utilization in the cloud if you're trying to deal with this very supply constrained environment. And somehow many people's intuition is the opposite of that."
paragraphs.cn: Altman在与油管主Cheeky Pint交谈时说：「从全球资源分配的角度来看，每个人都把世界上供应有限的一堆DRAM放在自己的电脑里，而且只有5%的时间在使用，这实际上很糟糕。就是说，如果你想应对这种供应非常紧张的环境，你会希望云端的利用率达到最高。不知为什么，许多人的直觉恰恰相反。」

paragraphs.en: The comments were widely ridiculed, with many suggesting that, whether he intended it or not, Altman sounded like he wanted to take away personal ownership of memory and force society to use resources for the benefit of AI companies such as his. Social media was flooded with posts, images, and videos of people slamming Altman for the suggestion, promising to protect their memory from any who might try to claim it. Even tech rival Elon Musk joined the backlash with a meme of his own .
paragraphs.cn: 这番言论遭到广泛嘲讽，许多人认为，无论Altman是否有意，他听起来都像是想剥夺个人对内存的所有权，并迫使社会使用资源来让他自己的公司等AI企业受益。社交媒体上充斥着批评Altman这一提议的帖子、图片和视频，人们誓言要保护自己的内存，不让任何可能试图夺走它的人得逞。就连科技界竞争对手Elon Musk也发布了一张自己的梗图，加入了批评的行列。

paragraphs.en: The people deserve to have their RAM too! https://t.co/q6dwauALw4
paragraphs.cn: 人们也应该拥有自己的内存！https://t.co/q6dwauALw4

paragraphs.en: Now, in a series of posts on social media, Altman expressed frustration at the online response, insisted his comments had been taken out of context, and even joked about the situation, renaming his X / Twitter name to 'Ram Altman' at the suggestion of a follower.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，Altman在社交媒体上发布了一系列帖子，对网上的反应表示沮丧，坚持称自己的言论被断章取义，甚至还就此开起了玩笑：他听从一名关注者的建议，将自己在X / X上的名字改为「Ram Altman」。

paragraphs.en: Altman said he actually wants the world to have “tons of memory,” and for people “to put as much as they want in their computers.” He added that it was “f***ing annoying” that this was “taken out of context.”
paragraphs.cn: Altman表示，他实际上希望世界拥有「大量内存」，也希望人们「想在自己的电脑里装多少就装多少」。他补充说，这番话被「断章取义」让人「他妈的烦」。

paragraphs.en: “I have been arguing for the world to ramp up memory production for a long time,” he continued.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「很长一段时间以来，我一直在呼吁全世界扩大内存产量。」

paragraphs.en: Here, Altman isn’t denying that he believes RAM would be better served in data centers, rather that there is enough RAM to go around. "I want you to have so much RAM," Altman said in another reply . "Let's build more."
paragraphs.cn: Altman在这里并没有否认他认为内存放在数据中心会发挥更大作用，而是在说内存足够所有人使用。Altman在另一条回复中说：「我希望你拥有很多内存。让我们生产更多吧。」

paragraphs.en: The response to Altman’s response was, predictably, further memes and dunks, with many, particularly within the PC gaming community, continuing to hit out at the tech billionaire’s views.
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，Altman的回应引来了更多梗图和嘲讽，许多人，尤其是PC游戏社区内的人，继续抨击这位科技界亿万富翁的观点。

paragraphs.en: Altman had initially taken to X / Twitter to issue a statement that some are taking as a response to the Democrats’ decisive victory over Trump’s Republicans during yesterday’s U.S. midterm elections. The Democrats have now taken control of U.S. Congress, which perhaps signals a change in approach the regulation of AI, which up to this point has been pretty much nonexistent.
paragraphs.cn: Altman最初在X / X上发表了一份声明，一些人认为这是对民主党在昨天的美国中期选举中决定性战胜特朗普领导的共和党的回应。民主党如今已掌控美国国会，这或许预示着AI监管方式将发生变化；截至目前，这方面的监管几乎不存在。

paragraphs.en: “People should always be in control of the future,” Altman tweeted . “OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that ‘AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans.’
paragraphs.cn: Altman发帖说：「人类应该始终掌控未来。OpenAI反对这样一种观念：让人类沦为只做那些『AI系统认为值得奖励人类去做的事』的角色是可以接受的。」

paragraphs.en: “People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.”
paragraphs.cn: 「人类不应该将未来的控制权拱手让给超级智能，而这一要求最终应该限制AI的发展。」

paragraphs.en: Data centers and the potential impact on jobs and humanity’s very existence from AI is a key issue for voters. Meanwhile, the AI boom has led to a scarcity of memory to power it, which in turn has caused graphics cards, video game consoles, and PC components to skyrocket in price. Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo have all raised the prices of their consoles as a result of the ‘RAMpocalypse,’ while the RTX 5080 just disappeared off of Nvidia's marketplace, weeks after the RTX 5090 was all but discontinued.
paragraphs.cn: 数据中心，以及AI对就业和人类自身生存可能产生的影响，是选民关注的一个关键问题。与此同时，AI热潮导致用于支持其运行的内存短缺，进而造成显卡、电子游戏主机和PC组件价格飙升。索尼、微软和任天堂都因这场「RAMpocalypse」上调了旗下主机的价格，而RTX 5080刚刚从Nvidia的商城下架，几周前RTX 5090才几乎完全停产。
